title: All Inboxes and the Calendar never show at once
steps: With two accounts, open All Inboxes, then open the Calendar from the toolbar
Go back to Mail and press J and K
Open the Calendar again and click All Inboxes in the sidebar
expected: The Calendar replaces All Inboxes completely, with no All Inboxes rows or search bar over it. Back to Mail shows All Inboxes again with J and K moving its selection. All Inboxes from the sidebar closes the Calendar. Inbox shows the mail list.
